errors.text_span: сортирани по низходящ ред според стойностите за 2023 г.
errors.evidence: The chart categories are sorted in ascending order based on the 2023 values when read from top to bottom, not descending order.
The chart has horizontal bars, so their 'length' (дължина) corresponds to the value, not their 'height' (височина).
The legend is located at the bottom center of the chart, not in the bottom left corner.
